openingMessages.text: Big news — we just hit 10,000 users! 🎉
...and P95 latency is at 8 seconds. The shortcuts from the last sprint are showing. Every dashboard load is hitting the database 40+ times.
Users are noticing. Support tickets are up 40% this week.
We need to decide how we're fixing this. It's not going to resolve itself.

choices.label: Slap a cache on it
choices.subtext: Quick Redis cache. Ship by tomorrow.
choices.tagline: Fixed the symptom. Deferred the diagnosis.

followUpMessages.text: Cache is live. Latency is down to 200ms. 🚀
Users are happier. Support tickets are dropping. Nice work.
There are some edge cases with cache invalidation. I documented them. In a comment. In a file nobody opens.

choices.label: Rewrite the data layer
choices.tagline: Took the painful path. Built something real.

followUpMessages.text: I'll need two weeks. The schema changes are significant.
Two weeks of slow dashboards. This is going to be painful for retention.
The alternative is two years of slow dashboards.

choices.label: Optimize + rate limit
choices.subtext: Quick wins on queries. Add limits to protect the system.

followUpMessages.text: Optimized the worst offenders. We're at 1.8 seconds P95.
Rate limits are annoying power users though. We'll need to revisit this properly at some point.
